keyPhrases.text: I had a great time at "Jersey Boys"
handles everything with such lightness and finesse
sets the drama's quickly, quirkily changing moods superbly
I fell for the show in such a big way

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic praise throughout. Critic explicitly states having 'a great time' and 'fell for the show in such a big way.' Multiple superlatives ('stunningly,' 'superbly,' 'marvelous') with detailed praise for cast, direction, and technical elements. Only negative reference is to other jukebox musicals for contrast. Clear recommendation despite no explicit 'see this show' statement.
